description: Verify the configured API key(s) and report each one's plan tier (live vs sandbox vs trial). Read-only. When both Q402_TRIAL_API_KEY and Q402_MULTICHAIN_API_KEY are set, returns BOTH summaries so the agent can show the user trial credits AND paid credits in one view. For trial-scoped keys, returns days-left + credits-remaining for the trial allotment. Free trial available at https://q402.quackai.ai/event - 500 gasless TX over 30 days. For per-chain gas tank balances, point the user at https://q402.quackai.ai/dashboard - those need a wallet signature, not a bare key.
name: q402_balance
